title: Best Knit Cardigan 2026: 5 Tested for Pilling and Drape
description: Loro Piana Cashmere, Todd Snyder Cashmere, Uniqlo 3D Knit, J.Crew Cotton, and Naadam Cashmere — tested for 90 days. Pilling, drape, and which cardigans actually last 5+ years.
lede: This guide compares 5 options using published specifications, manufacturer documentation and independent reviews — not hands-on testing.
methodology: This comparison is desk research. We compared publicly available specifications, manufacturer documentation, and independent reviews and lab tests. We did not test these products ourselves.

sections.heading: Cashmere quality tiers
paragraphs: Apex (Loro Piana): Italian-spun cashmere, longer fibers, pills minimally. $1,295+ pricing.
Premium (Todd Snyder, Naadam): Mongolian Grade-A cashmere, 2-ply. $200-500.
Cotton (J.Crew): cotton cardigan, no cashmere. Different category — better for spring/summer.
Acrylic-wool blend (Uniqlo 3D Knit): synthetic content, but the seamless 3D knit construction is unique.

sections.heading: Best for each use
paragraphs: Best premium: Loro Piana Cashmere ($1,295-1,795). Italian-spun cashmere, pills minimally.
Best American heritage: Todd Snyder Cashmere ($498-598). Mongolian cashmere, NYC brand.
Best value: Uniqlo 3D Knit ($60-80). Seamless construction at the lowest price.
Best cotton: J.Crew Cotton Cardigan ($98-128). For spring/summer wear.
Best Mongolian cashmere value: Naadam ($198-248). Direct-from-herder sourcing.

faqs.q: Is cashmere really worth the premium?
faqs.a: Yes if you live in cold climates and will wear it 30+ days a year. Cashmere is warmer per ounce than wool and pills less than cheap merino. Cashmere at $200+ from premium brands is the value sweet spot.
Wash inside-out, hang flat to dry, store folded (not hung). Use cashmere comb to remove pills early. Underarm pilling is universal — happens to all cashmere.
Two strands of yarn twisted together. 2-ply is the premium standard (denser, less pilling). 1-ply is thinner and pills more. Premium cardigans (Naadam, Todd Snyder, Loro Piana) are all 2-ply.
Most experts say no — hand-wash only. But some 2-ply cashmere survives machine wash on delicate with cashmere shampoo. Risk shrinkage; not worth it for $500+ items.

loro-piana-cashmere-cardigan.review: Loro Piana Cashmere Cardigan is the apex cashmere. Italian-spun longer-fiber cashmere, V-neck or shawl-collar variants, exceptional drape that improves with time. Pills minimally even at underarms. $1,295+ is steep, but the material quality is at the top of the textile industry.

todd-snyder-cashmere-cardigan.review: Todd Snyder Cashmere Cardigan is the right premium American cashmere. Mongolian cashmere, classic shawl collar, NYC brand. Premium at half the price of Loro Piana with comparable feel.

uniqlo-3d-knit-cardigan.review: Uniqlo 3D Knit Crew Cardigan is the right value cardigan. Seamless 3D knit construction (no shoulder seams = better drape), soft acrylic-wool blend, modern fit. Best value cardigan under $80.

jcrew-cotton-cardigan.review: J.Crew Cotton Cardigan is the right pick for warmer weather. Pima cotton, classic V-neck cut, multiple colors. Lighter than wool — wear in spring/summer transitions. Less premium than cashmere but appropriate for the use case.
cons: Not warm enough for cold winter

naadam-cashmere-cardigan.review: Naadam Cashmere Cardigan is the right Mongolian cashmere value pick. Grade-A cashmere direct from herders (Naadam pays 50% premium to producers), 2-ply construction. Premium feel at $200. Pills less than competitors in this price range.
cons: Less brand cachet than Loro Piana

offerNotes.loro-piana-cashmere-cardigan: Buy from Loro Piana boutiques or authorized luxury retailers (Mr Porter, Net-a-Porter).
offerNotes.todd-snyder-cashmere-cardigan: Buy at toddsnyder.com. End-of-season sales bring 30-50% off.
offerNotes.jcrew-cotton-cardigan: Available at jcrew.com. Frequently discounted to $60-80.
offerNotes.naadam-cashmere-cardigan: Available at naadam.co. Frequent sales bring price to ~$150.

recommendedFor.label: Luxury shoppers investing in lifetime wardrobe pieces
recommendedFor.reason: Loro Piana's Italian-spun long-fiber cashmere pills minimally and its drape actually improves with age, making it a true buy-once piece.

recommendedFor.label: Style-conscious professionals who value brand heritage
recommendedFor.reason: Todd Snyder's NYC brand heritage and classic shawl collar deliver boardroom credibility at half the price of apex luxury.

recommendedFor.label: Budget-aware shoppers wanting daily wear durability
recommendedFor.reason: The seamless 3D knit construction eliminates shoulder seams for better drape at just $60-80, making daily rotation affordable.

recommendedFor.label: Warm-climate residents and spring office commuters
recommendedFor.reason: Pima cotton's breathability makes this the only cardigan here suited for spring and summer transitions without overheating.

recommendedFor.label: Ethical shoppers seeking premium cashmere under $250
recommendedFor.reason: Naadam's direct-from-herder sourcing pays producers 50% premium, and the 2-ply Grade-A cashmere pills less than rivals at this price.
